# Independent sketch controls

Original project-authored XML and quadrant image, generated by
`tools/sketch_heldout_fixture.py`. These controls were created after recovering
the rectangle formula from the original sketch-regeneration and width sweep
controls. They vary previously untested seeds (including UINT32_MAX), odd
EMU dimensions, and outline widths 0/12700/38100/76200. Both rectangles and
ellipses are retained so the unresolved ellipse behavior remains observable.

The reference application opened the control and exported two PDF pages and a
separately saved DOCX using `tools/export-reference.ps1`. Geometry extraction
uses `python tools/extract_sketch_geometry.py tests/fixtures/sketch-heldout`. SHA-256 hashes
bind the independent artifacts in native-recording.json. No corpus artwork or
third-party engine code is included.

All rectangle and ellipse control points match the curved preview calculation. These controls do not establish freehand,
scribble, custom saved geometry, ambiguous seeds, or internal sketch editing. Supported drawings can be retained during text edits.
